title: NuGet Publish Executor
description: Publish a NuGet package to a feed (assumes package is already packed)

packagePath.description: Path to the .nupkg file (relative to workspace root). If not provided, will auto-discover.

source.description: NuGet feed URL to publish to

apiKey.description: API key for authentication (can also use NUGET_API_KEY environment variable)

dryRun.description: Run in dry-run mode (publishes to local feed instead)

skipDuplicate.description: Skip publishing if package version already exists on the server

dryRunSource.description: Local folder path for dry-run mode publishing
